horizon_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 3A - Evaluation Horizon & Statistical Power Assessment

horizon_parameters.nominal_calendar_duration: Approximately 1 calendar year (standard NYSE trading schedule)

statistical_power_analysis.power_conclusion: At N=30, the test has only a 52% probability of detecting a moderate shortfall improvement (d=0.35). Achieving >= 45-60 defensive sessions is strongly recommended to guarantee statistical power >= 80%.

stopping_and_extension_rules.fixed_starting_event: Trading day T_0 following owner execution of cryptographic activation token.
stopping_and_extension_rules.prohibition_of_optional_stopping: Continuous interim testing with early stopping on favorable p-values is STRICTLY PROHIBITED (inflates Type I error from 5% to > 20%).
stopping_and_extension_rules.contingent_extension_protocol: If at session 252, N_def < 30, the evaluation automatically extends until N_def = 30 or up to a maximum of 504 sessions. If after 504 sessions N_def < 30, the prospective trial is declared INCONCLUSIVE due to persistent low-volatility regime.
emergency_early_termination_criteria: Catastrophic divergence: D2 portfolio drawdown exceeds E0 drawdown by more than 300 bps at any point.
Critical unrecoverable accounting discrepancy exceeding $1.00 between broker state and independent oracle.
Persistent market data feed corruption lasting > 3 consecutive trading days.

owner_action_required.action: Owner must approve 252-day baseline horizon, N_def >= 30 floor, and contingent extension to 504 days.
